verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing pages describe automated granting with contract creation, signing and sharing, done one by one or in bulk, plus custom vesting and HRIS sync for new hires. This covers the core grant-issuance step. Nothing in the evidence mentions a board approval flow or 409A valuations or strike-price compliance, and the claims are vendor marketing only. Missing for 10: board approval workflow, 409A valuation and strike-price setting, evidence that these form one end-to-end flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
